operating_notes.text: Starworth Infrastructure & Construction received a ₹144.45 Cr item rate contract with a 28-month execution period.
Starworth Infrastructure received a ₹57.8 Cr LOI for Westin Hotel project civil works with 20-month execution period
Wholly-owned subsidiaries issued NCDs aggregating ₹1,017 Cr during FY26.
Starworth Infrastructure received a ₹133.34 Cr LOI (incl GST) from Sion Eden Developers for Embassy Eden civil works with a 34-month execution period.
Puravankara secured a 14.57-acre land parcel in Mandur, Bengaluru (7.92 acres JDA, 6.65 acres purchased) with 1.8 msft saleable area and ₹2,300 Cr GDV.
Puravankara signed a JDA for an 11.23-acre land parcel in North Bengaluru with a potential GDV of ₹1,100 crore.
Provided a ₹211.56 Cr corporate guarantee for NCDs amounting to ₹145 Cr issued by subsidiary Purva Oak Private Limited.
Puravankara recorded pre-sales of ₹1,439 crore in Q1FY27 across 1.36 msft.
Q1FY27 average realization rose 18% YoY to ₹10,589 per square foot.

Starworth Infrastructure & Construction (100% subsidiary) received a ₹175 Cr LoI excluding GST from Red Connect Private Limited for civil and structural works on the Ritz Carlton project at MRC Nagar, Chennai, over 32 months.
Puravankara added five land parcels in Bengaluru during FY27 totaling 49.76 acres and ₹6,300 crore in potential GDV.
Provided a ₹80 crore corporate guarantee for wholly owned subsidiary Purva Blue Agate's NCD issuance.
Secured redevelopment rights for a 4.68-acre project in Goregaon West, Mumbai, with an estimated GDV of ₹2,600 crore.
Entered Delhi-NCR market with a 13.44-acre land parcel in Greater Noida having ~4.57 msft saleable potential and ₹5,200 crore GDV.
Completed the transfer of entire equity shareholding in Purva Ruby Properties Private Limited for an estimated sale value of ₹145 crore, ceasing it to be a wholly owned subsidiary.
Allotted 250 NCDs of face value ₹10 Lakh each aggregating ₹25 crore as the fourth and final tranche of the ₹300 crore NCD fundraise approved on May 16, 2025.
Signed JDA for 12.76-acre Sathanur, North Bengaluru parcel with ~1.90 msft saleable area and estimated GDV of ₹2,500 crore.
FY27 business development to date: eight projects, ~12.64 msft development potential, ₹16,600 crore total potential GDV across Bengaluru, Mumbai and Delhi-NCR.
As of June 30, 2026, total land bank ~40 msft and ongoing projects 35.14 msft across nine cities.
Q2FY27 pre-sales ₹2,136 Cr (+62% YoY), collections ₹1,301 Cr (+24% YoY), realisation ₹11,651/sq ft (+32% YoY).
H1FY27 GDV additions ₹14,100 Cr across 10.74 msft; Q2FY27 alone 6.51 msft and ₹8,900 Cr.
Q2FY27 completions 0.41 msft at One Park Avenue, Mumbai; H1FY27 completions 2.13 msft.
Incorporated Burgundyprime Realty Private Limited as a 100% subsidiary for real estate development.

timeline.summary: Puravankara's subsidiary Starworth Infrastructure received a ₹144.45 Cr civil contract LOI from NPS Developers on 29 April 2026.
Puravankara received favourable appellate orders from CIT (Appeals) allowing Section 80-IB deductions for multiple assessment years, reducing tax liabilities.
Puravankara reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,501.92 Cr and a net profit of ₹109.95 Cr.
Puravankara's subsidiary Starworth Infrastructure received a ₹133.34 Cr LOI from Sion Eden Developers for Embassy Eden civil works.
Puravankara secured a 14.57-acre land parcel in Mandur, Bengaluru, with an estimated GDV of ₹2,300 Cr.
Puravankara provided a ₹211.56 Cr corporate guarantee to Catalyst Trusteeship for NCDs issued by its subsidiary Purva Oak Private Limited.
Puravankara Limited schedules Q1 FY27 earnings conference call on August 17, 2026, at 10:30 AM IST with Ashish Puravankara, Mallanna Sasalu, Rajat Rastogi, and Neeraj Gautam.
Puravankara delays the closure of its ₹145 Cr sale of Purva Ruby Properties Private Limited by 30 days to September 10, 2026
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹848.72 Cr (+61.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹28.93 Cr (against a loss of ₹67.68 Cr a year earlier).
Puravankara reported Q1FY27 revenue of ₹877 Cr and PAT of ₹25 Cr, with pre-sales rising 28% to ₹1,439 Cr.
Puravankara Limited shared the audio recording of its Analysts/Investors Call for Q1-FY27 results on 17.08.2026 via its website.
Puravankara held its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call on August 17, 2026, reiterating its FY27 presales guidance of ₹11,200 Cr.
On August 20, 2026, Puravankara announced a ₹199.99 Cr corporate guarantee for its subsidiary Provident Housing Limited.

On 21 August 2026, wholly owned subsidiary Starworth Infrastructure & Construction received a ₹175 Cr LoI (excluding GST) from Red Connect Private Limited for civil and structural works on the Ritz Carlton project at MRC Nagar, Chennai, to be executed over 32 months.
Puravankara announced a joint development agreement on August 25, 2026, for a 7.83-acre land parcel in South-East Bengaluru with ₹1,100 Cr GDV potential.
Puravankara provided a ₹80 crore corporate guarantee for its wholly owned subsidiary Purva Blue Agate's NCD issuance.
Puravankara secured a ₹2,600 crore redevelopment project in Goregaon West, Mumbai, taking its Mumbai portfolio GDV to ₹17,500 crore.
Puravankara issued a corrigendum to its FY25-26 annual report correcting non-material typographical errors regarding subsidiary classifications.
Puravankara announced the launch of Phase 6 of Provident Equinox by its wholly owned subsidiary Provident Housing Limited.
Puravankara entered the Delhi-NCR market by securing a 13.44-acre land parcel in Greater Noida with an estimated GDV of ₹5,200 crore.
Puravankara Limited’s 40th AGM held on September 25, 2026, via VC, chaired by Ashish Ravi Puravankara (MD) with Sudip Chatterjee (CS) welcoming attendees.
Puravankara reported an insider trading code violation by a designated person, resulting in a ₹5,000 penalty paid to SEBI IPEF.
Puravankara completed the sale of its 100% stake in subsidiary Purva Ruby Properties Private Limited to Prishal Office Parks III for about ₹145 crore.
Puravankara allotted 250 NCDs aggregating ₹25 crore as the fourth and final tranche of its ₹300 crore fundraise.

2026-10-12: Puravankara signed a JDA for a 12.76-acre land parcel in Sathanur, North Bengaluru, with about 1.90 msft saleable area and an estimated GDV of ₹2,500 crore, taking FY27 business development additions to eight projects, 12.64 msft and ₹16,600 crore of potential GDV.
2026-10-13: Puravankara reported Q2FY27 pre-sales of ₹2,136 Cr, up 62% YoY, collections of ₹1,301 Cr, up 24%, and ₹14,100 Cr of GDV added in H1FY27.
Puravankara incorporated Burgundyprime Realty Private Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary on October 19, 2026.
